initial_conditions: A fresh Harbor revision 23 contains two editable pieces and eight seams. Harbor front is selected in Front view, with Rotate pattern and World X enabled.
actions: Open a fresh revision 23 two-piece Harbor fixture. Select Harbor front in Front view, enable Rotate pattern and choose World X.
Drag the right-hand dial knob from (1053, 513) to (1044, 491) in native window points. Repeat the same drag. The fixed pivot remains visible at the same screen position.
Read each application revision. In the corrected run, save both turns, then Undo and save, and Redo and save.
expected_outcomes: The release advances one document revision after an owned dial press, including a release sharing its input frame with the first significant pointer movement. Undo and Redo restore the complete editable placements.
